notes:
{持参|じさん} means to bring something with you. It's a somewhat formal term often seen in written instructions.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持参|じさん}する

Common collocations:
- {持参|じさん}する (to bring)
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持参|じさん}してください (please bring ~)
- {持参|じさん}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧ (items to bring)
- ⟦{各自|かくじ}→各自：00157_kakuji⟧{持参|じさん} (each person brings their own)

Usage note: {持参|じさん} is more formal than ⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧ or ⟦{持|も}ってくる→持ってくる：10666_mottekuru⟧. It's commonly used in official notices, instructions, and forms.

Related expressions:
- ⟦{持|も}っていく→持っていく：27431_motteiku⟧ (to take/bring - casual)
- ⟦{持|も}ってくる→持ってくる：10666_mottekuru⟧ (to bring - casual)
- ⟦{携帯|けいたい}する→携帯する：21144_keitaisuru⟧ (to carry - formal)

ASPECT (ている):
- [X]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持参|じさん}している: has brought X (and currently has it with one) (resultative state, not "is bringing")
- Note: {持参|じさん}する describes the act of bringing something, but the ている form indicates the state of having brought and still possessing the item. "⟦{身分|みぶん}{証|しょう}→身分証：11508_mibunshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{持参|じさん}しています" means "I have my ID with me" (I brought it and still have it), not "I am in the process of bringing it."
